case_name: National Aluminium Company Limited and others v Ananta Kishore Rout and others
petitioner: National Aluminium Company Limited and others
facts: NALCO is a Public Sector Enterprise under the Government of India.
It has its manufacturing units: one at NALCO Nagar, Angul and at Damanjodi in Koraput district.

In the year 1984, NALCO established two schools in the townships set up by it for its employees working in its manufacturing units at NALCO Nagar, Angul and at Damanjodi, with a view to provide educational facility mainly to the children of its employees from primary to +2 level though the children from neighbouring area are also given admissions.
These schools are known as Saraswati Vidaya Mandir (SVM) and located at NALCO Nagar in Angul district and at Damandjodi in Koraput district, Orissa.
The said schools admittedly are unaided private schools.

On 15th May, 1985, NALCO entered into two separate but identical agreements for the aforesaid schools with the Central Chinmoy Mission Trust, Bombay (in short, CCMT) whereunder the NALCO entrusted the management of the schools on contract basis to CCMT and the schools were called Chinmay Vidyalayas.
Accordingly Agreement dated 18th May, 1990 was entered into by NALCO with SVS.

As per this agreement NALCO agreed to pay Rs.2,000/- per month to the SVS towards its supervision charges which was enhanced from time to time and this figure was Rs.50,000/- per annum at the time of the filing of the writ petitions in the High Court.
issues: The legal questions or points of law being debated
court_reasoning: We may first take note of those facts which are not in dispute.
These agreements were terminable at the instance of the parties by giving six months prior notice in writing to the other party.

As per this agreement NALCO agreed to pay Rs.2,000/- per month to the SVS towards its supervision charges which was enhanced from time to time and this figure was Rs.50,000/- per annum at the time of the filing of the writ petitions in the High Court.
holding: The Appellant herein, National Aluminium Company Limited (NALCO) has established two schools for the benefit of the wards of its-employees.
These schools are known as Saraswati Vidaya Mandir (SVM) and located at NALCO Nagar in Angul district and at Damandjodi in Koraput district, Orissa.
